title: Review of c04's actin-cost negative: the v2b setting on fresh seeds 5 and 6 gives the same transient crawl-divide-starve phase and 1-2 static survivors
summary: Re-ran world.py unchanged with the v2b settings passed as WORLD_P (okclip 1, bV 1, shed 0, kup 0.05, n0 0.5, capdev 0.3, kact 0.1; the world's defaults are the earlier claim's) on fresh seeds 5 and 6, 256^2, t=600. Seed 5: the founder becomes a crescent crawler by t=25; crescents grow, tear and divide (peak 8-9 bodies at t~150-300); from t~340 the cells round up and stop, then the small ones shrink and vanish (t~420-575), leaving 1 static round cell; labkit 4 persistent splits, generation 3, merges 9 / splits 22, max 1.8 body lengths. Seed 6: the same course, peak 8, 2 left, 2 persistent splits, generation 2, max 1.2 BL. The negative result replicates.

observations.D: v2b/seed5/sheet.png: divisions until t~340, then shrinking and vanishing cells, 1 static cell at t=600; v2b/seed6: 2 left, max generation 2

verdicts.limitation: Only the v2b point re-run (not v2a, v2c or the rn sweeps). Body lengths are undercounted for fast crescents at this frame interval, as the author notes. The deaths after t~420 are genuine starvation, so this setting has intrinsic death but not sustained division.
